The Supreme Court has upheld the Calcutta High Court's order cancelling 25,753 teaching and non-teaching staff appointments in Bengal's 2016 job-for-cash scam. While the BJP demands Mamata Banerjee's resignation, the Chief Minister accuses the BJP government of targeting Bengal and stands with the affected teachers.
